data.one_liner: A pure Dart port of ZXing to encode and decode multiple 1D and 2D barcodes.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of the ZXing library to encode and decode various 1D and 2D barcode formats like QR code, PDF417, Data Matrix, and Aztec across all platforms without native dependencies.
use_when: You need pure Dart barcode encoding and decoding for platforms like Web or Desktop where native plugins might not be ideal.
You want a barcode solution without depending on native platform SDKs.
avoid_when: You require high decoding speed and maximum accuracy on mobile devices, where native packages outperform this port.
You need real-time, high-performance scanning out-of-the-box.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with excellent cross-platform compatibility including Web and Desktop.
Supports encoding and decoding multiple barcode types (QR, PDF417, DataMatrix, Aztec, etc.).
No need to rely on native platform packages.
weaknesses: Inferior decoding speed and accuracy compared to native packages.
Floating-point differences in Dart cause some test results to differ from original ZXing.
